entries.title: I Corinthians 5:1
segments: It is actually reported that there is fornication among you, and such fornication as is not even among the Gentiles, that one [of you] hath his father's wife.

entries.title: I Corinthians 5:2
segments: And ye are puffed up, and did not rather mourn, that he that had done this deed might be taken away from among you.

entries.title: I Corinthians 5:3
segments: For I verily, being absent in body but present in spirit, have already as though I were present judged him that hath so wrought this thing,

entries.title: I Corinthians 5:4
segments: in the name of our Lord Jesus, ye being gathered together, and my spirit, with the power of our Lord Jesus,

entries.title: I Corinthians 5:5
segments: to deliver such a one unto Satan for the destruction of the flesh, that the spirit may be saved in the day of the Lord Jesus.

entries.title: I Corinthians 5:6
segments: Your glorying is not good. Know ye not that a little leaven leaveneth the whole lump?

entries.title: I Corinthians 5:7
segments: Purge out the old leaven, that ye may be a new lump, even as ye are unleavened. For our passover also hath been sacrificed, [even] Christ:

entries.title: I Corinthians 5:8
segments: wherefore let us keep the feast, not with old leaven, neither with the leaven of malice and wickedness, but with the unleavened bread of sincerity and truth.

entries.title: I Corinthians 5:9
segments: I wrote unto you in my epistle to have no company with fornicators;

entries.title: I Corinthians 5:10
segments: not at all [meaning] with the fornicators of this world, or with the covetous and extortioners, or with idolaters; for then must ye needs go out of the world:

entries.title: I Corinthians 5:11
segments: but as it is, I wrote unto you not to keep company, if any man that is named a brother be a fornicator, or covetous, or an idolater, or a reviler, or a drunkard, or an extortioner; with such a one no, not to eat.

entries.title: I Corinthians 5:12
segments: For what have I to do with judging them that are without? Do not ye judge them that are within?

entries.title: I Corinthians 5:13
segments: But them that are without God judgeth. Put away the wicked man from among yourselves.
